# Threshold
> Unique experiences run by the local people who started them. In Victoria, Australia and Bali.

Threshold is a booking site for small, owner-run experience businesses. Businesses get their first 6 months free. After that, 8% only when Threshold brings them a booking. No sign-up fee, no monthly cost, no contract.

## Pages
- [Home](https://thresholdbooking.com/)
- [Victoria, Australia](https://thresholdbooking.com/mornington-peninsula/)
- [Bali](https://thresholdbooking.com/bali/)
- [FAQ](https://thresholdbooking.com/faq/)
- [For businesses](https://thresholdbooking.com/for-business/)

## Salty Cowboy, Bali
Owner-run horse rescue and riding centre in Bali, run by Simone. 11 experiences: beach and rice field rides, photoshoots, and lessons from grooming to a 3-day Horse Whisperer course. Prices from IDR 1,250,000.
